scores.notes: Daniel in both is an older man with short grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, in a blue fringed robe with a shoulder satchel; face and build match.
Moses in both is an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, lean build, dark brown cloak over a pale tunic; left on the shore, right seated on the stone.

Peter (left, raising the lame man; right, the dripping-wet man by the fire) has the same dark curly hair greying at the temples, short grizzled beard, tanned weathered face and rough brown cloak in both.
Watson in both is the stocky man with brown hair, a brown moustache, dark overcoat, bowler hat and doctor's bag; face and build match.

Left Watson is stocky with dark brown hair and a heavy moustache; the right image has two candidates, a slim sandy-haired man being pulled in by Holmes (does not match) and a stocky dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag in the doorway (matches), so the subject is not singled out.
Moses in both has long white hair and a long white beard, a lean build, and a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a staff; left is seen from the side at a distance but hair and beard are clear.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair, tan skin and a slim build in a short brown tunic; the right figure is smaller but the cues are readable.
Moses in both is an elderly man with white swept-back hair, a full white beard, weathered tan face and dark brown cloak over a cream tunic; hair is slightly longer on the right but no cue conflicts.

Daniel in both is a lean older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin, in a dark blue fringed robe over a pale tunic with a scroll case at his hip; left is small in the pit but the cues are readable.

Left shows the house ablaze under a dark night sky with firelit grounds; right shows a daytime overcast scene at the station with only a smoke column behind trees, so night conflicts with day and neither passage asks for that change.

Watson in both is the stocky man with brown hair, a thick brown moustache and ruddy face in a dark coat (left with bowler and doctor's bag, right seated holding the hat); left is small but consistent.

Both show a night sea under heavy dark cloud with green-teal water drawn back on either side of a brown muddy seabed path and rocky hills beyond; left views it from the shore, right from inside the corridor, which is a compatible change of viewpoint.

Moses in both is an old lean man with white hair, a full white beard and weathered face, wearing a brown cloak over a cream tunic with a staff; hair is a little longer on the right but nothing conflicts.
Alice in both is a girl of about seven to ten with long light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face, in a yellow dress with white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Peter (left, the man at far left with hand on chest; right, the man stepping out of the boat) has the same dark curly hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned face and sturdy build in a rough brown cloak.
Peter (left foreground by the brazier; right standing on the boat's bow) has the same grey-flecked dark curly hair, short grey beard, tanned middle-aged face and brown cloak over a cream tunic.

David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with tousled dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left kneeling at the brook, right kneeling under the oil).
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in a short brown tunic (left kneeling under the oil, right dodging the spear).
Holmes in both is a gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead, hawk nose and hollow cheeks in a black frock coat; faces match closely.

Both show a circular pit lined with pale grey stone blocks sunk in sandy ground in pale early light, with a stone wall and steps beside it; the right adds a low parapet and palms but the layout is compatible from a different viewpoint.
Alice in both is a fair-skinned girl with long wavy light-brown hair and the same round face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Both are night scenes in flat English countryside with hedges and trees and a house fire throwing up smoke; left sees it as a distant blaze from the station, right close up from the drive, which is compatible, though left shows little of the house itself.

Moses in both is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and tanned lined face in a dark brown cloak over a cream tunic with a staff; hair looks shorter and skin a shade darker on the right but he is small there and no cue clearly conflicts.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with thick dark curly hair, tan skin and lean build in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder bag and sling.

Watson left (standing, arms crossed) and right (lying on the bed shielding his eyes) both have brown side-parted hair, a brown moustache, ruddy face and solid build in shirt sleeves and waistcoat; the right face is partly covered by his arm but hair and moustache match.

Moses in both is an old man with white swept-back hair, a full white beard and tanned face, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a crook staff; hair is a bit longer on the right but nothing conflicts.

Peter (left leaping from the boat, right stepping onto the water) has the same dark curly hair touched with grey, short dark grizzled beard, tanned face and stocky build in both; only the cloak differs.

On the left Jesus is a tiny distant figure on the cross on the hilltop, with no readable face, hair or beard, so he cannot be compared with the long-haired bearded man standing in the boat on the right.

Peter (left standing with the net by the fire, right foreground with hand at his chest) has the same dark curly hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned lined face and rough brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Both show a white-walled two-storey country house with a red-brown roof and end chimneys in flames after dark, with horse-drawn fire engines on the lawn, rose bushes beside a dirt drive and open fields behind; the facade is drawn a little differently (porch versus central gable) but the place and occasion are compatible.
Alice in both is a fair girl with long light-brown hair held by a dark headband and the same small-featured face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with dark curly hair, tan skin and lean build in a rough brown tunic with a pouch; his head is bowed on the left but hair, age and build match.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long wavy light-brown hair and a headband, the same round face and age, in a yellow dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings (left seated at the tea table, right standing in court).
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch.

Peter (left raising the lame man, right leaping from the boat) is in both a sturdy middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grizzled beard, tanned face and brown cloak; the hair reads greyer and more windblown on the right but stays within the same greying look.

Both show a mown, slightly patchy lawn enclosed by a long red-brick garden wall with tall trees and clipped greenery behind, in soft daylight; the right adds cypresses and a topiary hedge but the layout is compatible.

Both show the same kind of single-masted wooden fishing boat on open water with a hilly shore carrying a small village; the left is the calm with clearing twilight sky and the right the dark moonlit storm, a change the passages themselves ask for.

Left Peter has dark curly salt-and-pepper hair and a grizzled beard on a middle-aged face; the man diving from the boat on the right has pale grey-white, thinner hair and a white beard and reads clearly older.

Left Holmes (the tall man at the door pulling Watson in) is markedly balding with a bare crown and thin dark hair at the sides; right Holmes (tossing the paper ball) has a full head of slicked-back dark hair with a widow's peak, so the hairline conflicts though both are gaunt and clean-shaven.

Both show a night sea under broken storm cloud with a moon, blue-green water piled back from a tan sandy seabed path, and tawny cliffs with a walled town on the far right shore; left is from inside the corridor, right from the beach.

Moses in both is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and a lined tanned face in a dark brown cloak over a cream tunic with a crook staff; hair falls longer on the right but nothing clearly conflicts.
Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight light-brown to strawberry-blonde hair and the same small-featured face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Both show a corridor of seabed between towering green-teal walls of water under a dark night sky, with a rocky outcrop and low hills closing the far end; the ground is darker and muddier on the left and the left wall paler, but the place is compatible.

Peter (left foreground by the brazier; right the man with the net over his shoulder gripping the lame man's hand) has curly dark greying hair, a short grizzled beard, tanned face and brown cloak in both; he is smaller and a little darker-haired on the right but no cue conflicts.
Holmes in both is a tall gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, a high forehead and hawk nose in a long black frock coat; left facing into the room, right stooping in profile.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short dark beard, tan skin and slim build, in a cream tunic with a blue-grey mantle.
Watson in both is a solid man with brown side-parted hair, a thick brown moustache and ruddy face in a dark suit and waistcoat (left seated with the hat, right at the door with bowler and bag).

Daniel (left, the man being hauled out of the pit; right, foreground looking up) is in both a lean older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard in a dark blue fringed robe over a pale tunic with a scroll case; skin reads darker in the right night scene but hair, beard, age and build match.

Watson in both is a solid man with brown hair, a brown moustache and a bowler hat, in a dark suit with a doctor's bag (left seated in the carriage, right standing on the pavement); the right figure is small but consistent.

Both show a wet tan sandy seabed corridor between curling blue-green walls of water under pale broken cloud, with red sandstone cliffs on the far horizon; the viewpoint differs but the place is compatible.

Peter (left leaping from the boat, right standing by the fire holding the net) has the same dark curly hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned weathered face and stocky build in a dark brown cloak.

Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, tan skin and slim build in a cream tunic with a blue mantle; on the right he is in profile from behind but hair, beard and build match.

Both show a dark storm-clouded sea with deep teal water thrown back in white-crested walls from a wet brown sandy seabed; left is from the rocky shore as it opens, right from inside the corridor, a compatible viewpoint change.

Both show the same wet tan sandy seabed corridor between towering teal walls of water with white crests under dark storm cloud breaking to pale light at the far end; left has the walkers, right the chariots.

Left Watson (on the bed shielding his eyes) has dark brown hair and a dark moustache; the right image has two candidates, a slim sandy-haired man being pulled in by Holmes (does not match) and a stocky dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag in the doorway (matches), so the subject is not singled out.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long light-brown to strawberry-blonde hair and the same small-featured face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; she is drawn giant-sized on the left as the scene requires.

Peter (left standing on the bow reaching out; right the central man with the net over his shoulder and a staff) has curly dark greying hair, a short grizzled beard, tanned face and sturdy build in a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Both show a white-walled two-storey country house with a red tiled roof and tall chimneys burning at night, horse-drawn red fire engines on the grass in front, hedges and bare trees around and flat fields beyond; the roofline is drawn wider on the left but the place is compatible.

Peter (left foreground with hand on chest, right stepping out of the boat) is in both a sturdy middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grizzled beard and tanned lined face in a brown cloak; hair reads a little greyer on the left but within the same greying look.
